says: Today's commit helper reports a formatting failure when pnpm refuses to run outside a workspace.
proof: At PR 1530 repair head 722a6fe57, the named-path commit attempt refuses as not_formatted. Repeating its exact staged-copy formatter call exits 1 with ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_EXEC_NO_PACKAGE. The temporary directory has no package.json. The same files pass oxfmt --check in the checkout, and final format, lint, typecheck and field checks pass. The helper hides stderr and maps every formatter startup failure to not_formatted.
cost: A correctly formatted change cannot be committed through the helper, and its message sends the next agent toward changing bytes that are already correct.
